theorems.name: Submission.cmcdt_ims_series_current
theorems.statement: (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (ω : TestFormOn U n), Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n)) S.support → S ω = 0) → ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (X : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn U n), IsOpen U → ∑' r, (X r).mass ≠ ∞ → ∃ Y : GeometricCurrentOn U n, (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, HasSum (fun r => X r ω) (Y ω)) ∧ Y.mass ≤ ∑' r, (X r).mass ∧ Y.support ⊆ closure (⋃ r, (X r).support)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
